title: Triage cheat sheet
intro: Answer three questions before you build. The answer is your ladder step.
note: There is no approval gate: you decide. The dashboard shows later whether an agent behaves like a workflow.

questions.text: Are the steps always the same?
questions.hint: Same order, only the data changes.

questions.text: Is free text read or written?
Must it plan across tools or handle unknown cases?
questions.hint: The steps depend on what happens along the way.

footer: Several departments with their own agents? That is a multi-agent setup, the rarest case.
